shortDescription: Submit a job on IBM i system. This module functions like SBMJOB.

options.name: become_user
options.description: The name of the user profile that the IBM i task will run under. Use this option to set a user with desired privileges to run the task.

options.name: become_user_password
options.description: Use this option to set the password of the user specified in C(become_user).

options.name: check_interval
options.description: The time interval between current and next checks of the expected status of the submitted job. This option will be ignored if C(*NONE) is specified for option status.

options.name: cmd
options.description: A command that runs in the batch job.

options.name: parameters
options.description: The parameters that SBMJOB will take. Other than CMD, all other parameters need to be specified here. The default values of parameters for SBMJOB will be taken if not specified.

options.name: status
options.description: The expect status list. The module will wait for the job to be turned into one of the expected status specified. If one of the expect status specified matches the status of submitted job, it will return. If C(*NONE) is specified, the module will not wait for anything and return right after the job is submitted. The valid options are C(*NONE), C(*ACTIVE), C(*COMPLETE), C(*JOBQ), C(*OUTQ).

options.name: time_out
options.description: The max time that the module waits for the submitted job is turned into expected status. It returns if the status of the submitted job is not turned into the expected status within the time_out time. This option will be ignored if C(*NONE) is specified for option status.
